reviews.text: Upcoming game I am keeping my eye out for.
This game is made by a Russian developer. Buying it may support Russia’s war effort financially (taxes, donations) or ideologically (spreading propaganda, normalizing aggression, amplifying hate).
A stylish roguelite that pairs relentless combat with a distinctive post apocalyptic world and rewarding build variety.
A good pick for players who enjoy challenging roguelites with plenty of build variety and replayability.

После глобальной войны с машинами города ушли под воду. Остатки человечества прячутся в подводных бункерах, а вы играете за добровольца, который поднимается на ржавые надводные платформы для сбора рес
Fast runs reward sharp movement and smart builds in a flooded world of machines. Day and night perks shift priorities mid run, making each attempt feel tense, varied, and worth another try.
